attempts: Use case: background-extraction. Reference image is a shallow front view of a black glass built-in gas cooktop after pot removal. Reconstruct this cooktop as one clean photorealistic isolated RGBA object with actual transparent background. Keep the very LOW camera elevation and wide shallow projection: full silhouette approximately 214 units wide by 32 units tall, horizontal front edge, parallel horizontal rear edge, short receding side edges as reference. Preserve the black glass base, four gas burners arranged two front/two rear, and coherent black cast-iron pan supports. Repair malformed fragmented grates into plausible continuous supports. No pots, pans, cookware, countertop, granite, wall, cabinet, labels, text, external cast shadow or checkerboard. Glass between burners is opaque black reflective glass, not transparent holes. Outside silhouette is truly transparent. Do not switch to a top-down catalog view or inflate projected depth. Entire object within canvas with generous transparent margins. Neutral soft interior lighting, realistic restrained highlights, no beige fringe. Output only the isolated cooktop, landscape canvas.

Edit ONLY this generated cooktop image. Preserve the cooktop geometry, all four burners, cast iron grates, black glass, knobs, proportions, camera angle and highlights exactly. Remove the entire painted gray-white checkerboard and its pale streaks. Replace that background with actual transparent alpha (RGBA), not a representation of transparency. Make all background visible through open spaces between grates transparent too, but keep black glass and burner interior opaque. No checkerboard pixels, no white matte, no shadow beyond the object. Output the identical isolated cooktop with TRUE transparent background. Do not redesign the object. Keep the whole cooktop in frame.

Create a photorealistic black four-burner gas cooktop cutout on a transparent background (RGBA alpha). Use the attached reference for its shallow frontal perspective and very wide 6.7:1 object silhouette. Rebuild clean continuous cast iron grates and glossy black glass. No pots or pans. No kitchen, stone, surface, backdrop, checkerboard pattern, text or diagram. Only the complete cooktop centered with transparent margins. The background must contain no visible pattern or color. Keep front and rear glass edges horizontal; preserve the reference's low camera angle.
